}}'''Vestas''' is a [[captain]] in [[Gareth Bryne|Gareth Bryne's]] army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vestas}}

==Appearance==
Captain Vestas is a man who has a deep voice.

== Activities ==
He is one of the men that accompanies Bryne, [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Gawyn Trakand]] into the [[White Tower]] during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]] to rescue [[Egwene al'Vere]]. They engage a [[Seanchan]] attack and reports back to Bryne the casualty report.{{ref/book|12|41}}
